Tese de Doutorado (Linguística e Língua Portuguesa), UNESP Araraquara. 214 pp. https://repositorio.unesp.br/handle/11449/155878

sources.note: Nothing. Ch. 4 'A fonologia de línguas orais e de línguas de sinais' (pp. 73-94) treats Stokoe parameters (handshape, location, movement, orientation, non-manuals), the L-M-L sign syllable and minimal/analogous pairs in LTS; the only prosody remarks (pp. 47-48) are generic statements about sign languages citing Pfau 2010 / Sandler 1999 (non-manuals behave like intonational contours, define prosodic words and intonational phrases). No statement on stress, prominence or accent in Terena Sign Language.
